boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of California-Santa Cruz, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A gentle first-weekend sequence that starts with campus bearings, adds student-life stops, and ends with a daylight coastal visit.

cards.title: Start at Cowell College
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · get your bearings
cards.notes: Use the college’s self-guided tour materials to identify the courtyard, dining hall, gallery, and other named Cowell locations before branching out.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a compact orientation stop in one of UCSC’s residential colleges.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowell College publishes a self-guided tour with named stops including its courtyard, dining hall, gallery, library, and coffee shop.
cards.access_notes: Use the college’s published tour and map information; follow posted building-access rules.

cards.title: Find the campus crossroads
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · central campus
cards.notes: Pause at Quarry Plaza to orient yourself to the nearby Student Union, Bay Tree Building, shuttle stops, and routes toward the academic core.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed central waypoint for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC’s Quarry Plaza map places the plaza near the Student Union, Bay Tree Building, and campus shuttle and Metro stops.
cards.source_title: UC Santa Cruz Quarry Plaza Map
cards.access_notes: Check the current interactive map and transit information before relying on a route or stop.

cards.title: Locate the Bay Tree Bookstore
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Quarry Plaza
cards.notes: Make this a practical landmark stop: note its location by Quarry Plaza and use the campus map to connect it with nearby services.
cards.short_summary: A named campus-store landmark beside Quarry Plaza.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC campus map lists Baytree Bookstore/Building and Quarry Plaza/Campus Store among campus facilities.
cards.access_notes: Consult the store directly for current offerings and hours.

cards.title: Set up at McHenry Library
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · academic core
cards.notes: Walk through McHenry and choose a future study spot; students can reserve study rooms when they need a focused group-work location.
cards.short_summary: Pair campus exploration with a useful study-space orientation.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library identifies McHenry Library and states that 36 of its study rooms are in McHenry.
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are intended for UCSC students to work and study; reserve one through the library when needed.

cards.title: See the Dead Central exhibit
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · McHenry Library main floor
cards.notes: If the library is open, visit the main-floor gallery and check its current exhibition materials before planning a longer return visit.
cards.short_summary: A free, public gallery stop inside McHenry Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Dead Central is a gallery on McHenry Library’s Main Floor; its exhibits are free and open to the public during McHenry Library hours.
cards.source_title: Dead Central Exhibits – UCSC University Library
cards.access_notes: Visit during current McHenry Library hours; exhibition content may change.

cards.title: Check the Student Union area
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Quarry Plaza
cards.notes: Use this named campus landmark as a reset point, then look up current student events and campus spaces through the university’s involvement hub.
cards.short_summary: A central place to connect the map with current campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: The UCSC campus map lists the Student Union in the Quarry Plaza area, and UCSC’s involvement hub directs students to campus spaces and events.
cards.source_title: Explore Slug Life – Get Involved at UCSC
cards.access_notes: Check the involvement hub for current events and space details rather than assuming a particular program is running.

cards.title: Walk past East Field
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · recreation district
cards.notes: Use the map-listed field and nearby East Field House to learn where recreation facilities are, then check current programs before joining an activity.
cards.short_summary: A daylight campus walk that introduces the recreation side of UCSC.
cards.evidence_claim: UCSC’s campus map lists East Field and East Field House, while UCSC describes recreation options including outings, aquatics, gear rental, and group fitness.
cards.source_title: Explore Slug Life – Get Involved at UCSC
cards.access_notes: Program availability and participation requirements vary; verify them with UCSC Recreation.

cards.entity_name: UC Santa Cruz Arboretum & Botanic Garden
cards.title: Take a garden walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · south campus
cards.notes: Follow garden etiquette by staying on paths and leaving plants in place; plan the visit during published daily garden hours.
cards.short_summary: A student-free garden visit with clear care guidelines.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arboretum is open daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m., and current UCSC students receive free admission; visitors are asked to stay on paths and not collect plants.
cards.source_title: Visit – UC Santa Cruz Arboretum & Botanic Garden
cards.access_notes: Bring current UCSC student identification for student admission; gardens publish holiday closures and etiquette rules.

cards.title: Choose a daylight Natural Bridges visit
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Santa Cruz coast
cards.notes: Stay on designated routes, view the natural bridge from shore, and use the tide pools only when conditions are safe and low tide permits.
cards.short_summary: A state-park coastal stop for a low-key daylight outing.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks lists Natural Bridges State Beach as open 8 a.m. to sunset and identifies its sea arch, beach, tide pools, and monarch butterflies.
cards.source_title: Natural Bridges State Beach – California State Parks
cards.access_notes: Park hours are 8 a.m. to sunset. Vehicle day-use parking has a posted fee; observe surf and tide-pool safety guidance.

cards.title: End by locating the Science & Engineering Library
cards.subtitle: Sunday late afternoon · academic planning
cards.notes: Save this library on your campus map and return when coursework calls for it; its study rooms are intended for UCSC students to work and study.
cards.short_summary: Finish the weekend by marking another dependable academic resource.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library states that it has 16 study rooms in the Science & Engineering Library and that study rooms are intended for UCSC students to work and study.
cards.access_notes: Check current library hours and reserve a room only when a study need arises.
